verdict.rationale: Omnara has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. The only route is indirect: it is Apache-2.0 and free to self-host, and it can use a compatible model you host yourself, so data can stay within your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: a documented policy on whether Omnara's hosted service uses customer data for training, an opt-out control, statements on the training terms of upstream model providers, and independent corroboration.
